content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text weighs the defender's link against the challenger's link by reading each side's own chain against the other, which is exactly the chain-against-chain collision K-C governs.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter", "rule_words": "that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side", "room": "the judge's phrase 'does not name Joseph as the begetter' read against the definition's 'never by whether any verse, or the chain as a whole, states it word for word': on one reading the judge, having already granted footing, counts the chain's lack of an explicit naming as its defect, which is the retired stating-verse test applied at chain level; on the other reading the judge means only that the chain's support never reaches the Joseph-as-begetter claim, a pure footing shortfall; I weigh the first reading because the defect is phrased as a failure to name while footing is separately granted by 'is footed but'.", "why": "Having called the challenger's chain footed, the judge still held against it that it never names Joseph as the begetter, judging by what the chain states word for word rather than by footing alone, which is the stating-verse test K-C retires at a judge's seat for either side."}
